review_candidates.title: ABAP Senior Developer Full Stack (Fiori)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and developing ABAP-based solutions that align with our organization's needs. The Senior ABAP Developer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including SAP functional consultants, project managers, and enterprise architects, to ensure that the solutions meet business requirements and are scalable, secure, efficient, and reliable. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Technical Development: o Develop, modify, and enhance custom SAP
eligibility_evidence: • Desired experience of IT services in complex multinational environments • Holder of relevant certifications for Fiori, BTP, ABAP on Cloud, is a plus.
We bring together more than 30,000 people from over 70 nationalities, coming from five continents.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Senior ABAP Developer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including SAP functional consultants, project managers, and enterprise architects, to ensure that the solutions meet business requirements and are scalable, secure, efficient, and reliable. o Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and implement solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing SAP modules. o Participate in and support unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developments meet the specified requirements and are free from defects. • 8+ years of IT Experience in the development of customer systems across multiple technology domains.
